verdict.rationale: Stable offers a nationwide registered agent product (stable-docs-27, stable-docs-19). Its docs describe adding a registered agent Location to an existing Organization so a company can receive service of process and state correspondence (stable-docs-31, stable-docs-5, stable-docs-22). That legal mail flows into the same digital inbox and routing tools used for the mailbox (stable-docs-20), so the service sits on the same account as the mailbox. Missing for 10: pricing or plan details showing how registered agent service is bundled with or added to a mailbox plan, a detailed service-of-process handling workflow (alerts and escalation for legal papers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
